instructions: Review this as a VS Code integration for the mirrord CLI. Prioritize extension lifecycle and concurrency bugs, debug-configuration preservation, cross-platform behavior (Windows, macOS, and Linux), safe binary download/update behavior, and compatibility with the mirrord CLI contract. Compare behavior with metalbear-co/mirrord-intellij when a feature is shared by both IDE integrations. Keep comments high-signal. Do not comment on formatting, whitespace, import ordering, or other issues enforced by ESLint and the TypeScript compiler. Do not request comments that merely restate the code.

rules.rule: Changes to mirrord command construction, environment variables, version checks, download URLs, platform detection, or CLI output parsing must remain compatible with the corresponding behavior in metalbear-co/mirrord. Flag guessed flags, output formats, binary names, or platform mappings that are not supported by the CLI.

When adapting a VS Code debug configuration for mirrord, preserve the user's original program, arguments, environment, working directory, debugger type, and stop-on-entry behavior unless the feature explicitly owns that field. Flag in-place mutations that can leak into later sessions or merges that overwrite unrelated user configuration.

Commands, providers, listeners, trackers, output channels, status bar items, and other VS Code Disposables created by the extension must be registered in ExtensionContext.subscriptions or explicitly disposed. Background work must not outlive extension deactivation in a way that mutates VS Code state.

Do not add synchronous filesystem, process, or network work to activation or debug-session hot paths. Await required work, keep intentionally background work observable and error-handled, and avoid races between binary updates and session startup.
